metadata.chapter_subtitle: Meteorological conditions that drive wildfire ignition and spread

inventory.summary: The chapter was technically solid but opened too abruptly for first-time readers and needed a clearer notation bridge into the fire-weather formulas.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block for first-time readers.
Key symbols were introduced quickly without enough framing around their physical meaning.
The opening needed a clearer transition from operational fire danger to the mathematical model.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added learner-facing setup and improved the transition into the notation and model structure.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified the physical meaning of the main symbols before formal derivations.
Smoothed the pacing from wildfire context to the fire-weather model.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces the model more gently while preserving the fire-weather mechanics and operational framing.

repair.summary: The onboarding and pacing issues were repaired during the editorial rewrite.
actions_taken: Explained core notation in physical terms.
Improved the transition from narrative context to formulas.

design_review.summary: The chapter's operational examples and index structure now do more explanatory work for a new reader.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support by framing the equations as linked physical processes.
